definitions.explanation: Knowledge or skills in a particular field acquired through study or experience. Used in professional and academic contexts.

examples.japanese: {専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧IT⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: This job requires specialized knowledge of law.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧ (specialty) and ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧ (knowledge). Refers to deep knowledge or skills in a particular field, acquired through study or professional experience.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have expertise
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire expertise
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: expertise is required
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧: to put expertise to use
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧: to be rich in expertise

USAGE:
Very common in job listings (⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧), business discussions, and academic contexts. Often paired with a field: IT⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{専門知識|せんもんちしき}, ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{専門知識|せんもんちしき}, ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{専門知識|せんもんちしき}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧: expert, specialist
- {専門性|せんもんせい}: expertise, specialization (abstract quality)
